Port Specification
10/100BaseT(X)Auto

Store and Forward(full wire-speed)

10BASE-T: Cat3, 4, 5 UTP(<250 meter)

V1: Power indicator light
V2: Power indicator light
V3: Power indicator light
PWR: Power indicator light
VLAN: Port isolation indicator light
S: Ultra long distance indicator light(10M)
Port orange/green indicator light: Link indicator light
V1: 12-57V 1A MAX
Input method V2: 12-57V 1A MAX
V3: DC12-57V 1A MAX(Internal positive and external negative)
Operating Temperature -40°C~+75°C
Humidity 10%~90% RH No condensation
Storage Temperature -40°C~+85°C
Humidity 5%~95% RH No condensation
Dimension Device: 156*119*35mm
L*W*H Packing Box: 235*165*78mm
N.W/G.W(Kg) 0.87Kg/1.03Kg
Lightning 6KV 8/20us, 8KV ESD electrostatic protection
Protection level
IP40

Desktop, Wall, Rack mountable(with mounting hangers)
Certificate
CE-EMC EN55032; CE-LVD EN62368
FCC Part 15Class B; RoHS
